title: About the Project
intro: This is a personal project by Jurijs Ivanovs.

goal.title: My Goal
goal.description: My main goal is to make Nutri-Score labeling mandatory in Latvia. I believe that having clear nutrition information directly on price tags helps everyone make healthier food choices more easily.
